title: Day 757: Bound Man Left With Narco-Message in Aguaruto; Second Man Shot Dead at Mazatlán Home
detail: The Sinaloa Attorney General's Office (FGE) reported three intentional homicides for Wednesday, August 19, 2026, two of them men killed in separate attacks. In Culiacán, a man was found around 2:00 PM on an unpaved street in the Las Coloradas sector of the Aguaruto district, west of the city — his hands and feet bound behind him with orange rope, a red blanket over his body, and an intimidating message left on white cardboard on his chest. In Mazatlán, Ignacio 'N', 29, was shot as he arrived at his home in the Antonio Toledo Corro neighborhood. No arrests were reported in either case.

media.caption: Man found bound with an intimidating message in the Aguaruto district of Culiacán, August 19, 2026

title: Day 757: Fourth Escuinapa Feminicide of August — Mireya, 50, Shot Outside Her Home
detail: Mireya 'N', 50, a crab vendor, was shot multiple times on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, while sitting outside her home on Melchor Ocampo Street in the Centro neighborhood of Escuinapa, in the company of acquaintances. A young assailant arrived, drew a firearm, and opened fire without warning; Red Cross paramedics confirmed she had no vital signs. The FGE opened a feminicide investigation. It was Escuinapa's fourth feminicide of August 2026 — coming five days after 20-year-old Perla 'N' was killed inside a clothing store in the same municipal center — and the 13th woman killed statewide in Sinaloa that month.

media.caption: Escuinapa registers its fourth feminicide of August 2026 with the killing of Mireya 'N', 50
